correctness.rationale: Begin with all 924 weight-six words; imposing self-overlap exclusions leaves 272 unbordered words. For distinct vertices an edge requires both cross-overlap orders to pass for every k=1,...,11 and aligned Hamming distance at least 4. This gives exactly the admissible codes as cliques in a graph with 11,206 edges. The independent enumeration (independent_enum.py, initialized by a 40-vertex measured run) used pivoted Bron–Kerbosch and found 4,887,344 maximal cliques, with counts by size 6–13 of 2648, 40764, 437600, 1883356, 1870068, 584172, 63740 and 4996. In each call P and X contain unvisited and already assigned common neighbors; a maximal extension not already assigned must meet P outside the pivot neighborhood, since otherwise the pivot would extend it. Moving each processed branch vertex to X partitions the extensions, and P=X=empty emits exactly a maximal clique. Hence no larger code can exist and all 4996 optima are included. Reversal and complement preserve the graph and commute; independent checks of all optima give zero fixed codes for each of the three nonidentity maps, 1249 orbits of size four, and distance exactly 4 in every optimum. The newly generated 844324-byte catalogue is byte-for-byte identical to the frozen optimizers.txt, with SHA-256 63a11362c2775f93caebe0a2c00b94afddf3d4e2aab491055efdb9dabf18fdea. The frozen scripts were inspected but not executed. This is exhaustive at length 12 alone; it makes no claim of substitution-robust framing.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Even knowing the exact relaxed maximum 72 gives no upper bound of 13 by itself: one must account for distance incompatibilities across the candidate balanced words, and there is no reduction from the differently constrained exact tables. The independently reproduced enumeration is the step establishing maximum, equality cases and stabilizers.

evidence: Strict 1-WMU forbids every positive proper overlap, including self-overlap, and is the same synchronization property as mutual uncorrelatedness here. The ranked Resultary matches instead change length, change admissible pairs, or impose other constraints.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Weight six is exact binary balance and fixed weight makes distances even, so minimum distance 4 is equivalent here to aligned single-substitution correction. This does not require treating substitutions as synchronization errors or imposing reverse-complement closure.

value.rationale: This is a useful finite benchmark at a block length already tabulated for the balanced framing problem. The added distance floor is the natural one-aligned-substitution correction requirement at fixed weight, not an arbitrary extra filter. The maximum gives a precise capacity comparison with the balance-only value 72; the full classification lets a researcher select among, or benchmark searches against, all optimal designs up to the two natural global symmetries. Neither the relaxed capacity nor a single construction supplies these facts. No biological application or robustness of boundary detection under errors is asserted.
